subject: Rear caliper: clip, guide screws and carrier bolts, on a 2010 BMW 328i (E90) with the 3.0L inline-6, shown so a home mechanic can see what the step is about. Step: "Remove the anti-rattle clip".

mustShow.text: HERO: A floating disc-brake caliper on the rear rotor seen from the outboard side with the wheel removed.
A spring clip on the front of the caliper that comes off by hand or with a screwdriver.
Two hex-head bolts (16 mm) on the back side of the caliper carrier.
